assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: original PC game main-menu key art, landscape 1536x1024, no text or UI.
Create a beautiful finished hand-painted gouache storybook scene for a warm garden adventure game about a small animal traveller who cooperates with a translucent memory companion. An apricot fox gardener wearing an oversized sage-green rain cape, burnt-orange scarf and tiny canvas mail satchel stands with a small mint translucent fox echo, beside a cozy lantern tent and a wooden postbox on a sunlit meadow path. They are small within a generous landscape, occupying the right middle third. A winding cream path leads toward distant mint coastal houses, peach dunes and a honey-gold hilltop observatory, forming a coherent expansive travel world. Foreground buttercups, rounded wild grasses, fern shapes, distant layered trees; beautiful deliberate graphic silhouettes, fine coloured pencil edges, subtle physical paper grain, sophisticated restrained color blocking, charming dry-brush edges and sunlit atmosphere. Large quiet pale cream sky and washed foliage on the LEFT 38 percent with very low detail so we will overlay the menu title and buttons there. Warm ivory, celadon, butter yellow, terracotta, muted blue, rich dark moss accents. Soft dimensional light, organic shapes, substantial painterly craft, feeling of wonder and companionship. High quality boutique indie game painted illustration, visually legible, art-directed, no black outlines, no harsh neon, no darkness/apocalypse, no gradients that look like generic UI, no plastic 3D, no generic vector clip art, no written symbols or letters, no existing game characters or recognizable copyrighted environments. Full-bleed illustrated game background.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D top-down cozy action game character SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 1536x1152 canvas, transparent background.
There are exactly TWELVE equally-sized 384x384 cells in a strict invisible grid. One separate centered character per cell, each with at least 60px clear padding inside its own cell, no overlap between cells, all characters face RIGHT in top-down three-quarter game view, no shadows outside cells, no props floating between cells. Do NOT draw grid lines, labels, letters, numbers or other text.
Art direction: sophisticated warm hand-painted gouache storybook game art, crisp readable silhouettes, gently textured edges, warm ivory highlights, soft dimensional shading, coloured-pencil details, dark moss thin contours, restrained palette of sage green / apricot / honey / cream. Cozy, humorous, beautiful boutique indie game craft, not childish clipart, no hard black outline, no glossy 3D. Characters large and individually readable at 48px. True transparent background preserving alpha.
Row1 column1: small apricot fox gardener traveller with sage cape, burnt-orange scarf, little cream muzzle, orange fox ears, little seed wand aiming right. Row1 column2: same fox as a friendly pale mint translucent memory echo with pale gold scarf. Row1 column3: a cute round mossy green leaf blob with two tiny dot eyes and leaf sprout. Row1 column4: a buttery lilac moth with rounded wings and cream face.
Row2 column1: a cinnamon mushroom creature in a little cap holding an acorn throwing sling toward right. Row2 column2: a stout ochre acorn turtle with mossy segmented shell. Row2 column3: small pale teal paper swallow messenger with amber satchel. Row2 column4: round pink peony sprite holding a seed bell.
Row3 column1: a round friendly little persimmon pumpkin with speckled confetti leaves, no scary face. Row3 column2: a cream teapot character with mint tea steam and tiny legs. Row3 column3: cozy small cream canvas tent with honey lantern and flower bed, top-down. Row3 column4: lush round sage green tree canopy with a little warm brown visible trunk, top-down.
All twelve items must stay strictly inside their own equally spaced 384x384 tiles, artwork same scale and rendered finish. No environmental background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D top-down ground texture atlas for an original cozy garden adventure game.
Create exactly a 3-column by 2-row evenly sized grid of SIX square 512x512 texture swatches on a 1536x1024 image. No gaps, no borders, no labels, no text. Each cell is an independently seamless tile of ground viewed straight down, hand-painted gouache with colored-pencil grain, organic dry-brush speckling, excellent subtle material detail, restrained warm natural colors, not flat vector art. These are BACKGROUNDS UNDER GAMEPLAY: low contrast, no large objects, no cliffs, no characters, no buildings, no trees, no shadows suggesting colliders, no perspective/horizon. Fine-scale marks, enough quiet space for colorful sprites.
Top left cell: pale warm sage meadow grass with tiny clover marks and a few butter-yellow petals, lightly mottled organic lawn.
Top middle: apricot sandy village ground, fine sandy grain, tiny terracotta pebbles and warm ivory speckles.
Top right: pale mint shoreline grass with subtle cool celadon speckling, a few tiny smooth sea pebbles. NO water or shore border.
Bottom left: soft faded rose and terracotta festival garden paving, subtly irregular large flat cobblestones with quiet pale cream grout, not geometric perfect grid.
Bottom middle: honey-cream hilltop meadow with delicate golden dried grass strokes and tiny white wildflower specks.
Bottom right: beautiful plain warm ivory handmade watercolor paper texture.
Every tile edge must visually blend into its opposite edge so it can repeat, evenly lit diffuse afternoon sun, no radial shading or obvious repeating big objects. Sophisticated painted material rather than noisy photographic texture.
